title: Some questions
creator: merovinger
content:
Hi.

I have installed and set up the new app via the playstore. Installed on a Pixel 8a. I have noticed the following points. Please give me some feedback on where and how I have to change the settings or whether these points can be changed at all.

1. I have three mailboxes in the app. If you swipe to the right, you can see the overview of the mail accounts with a corresponding abbreviation of 2 letters. All three accounts are named “WE”. It is possible to change that ?

2. I have set the frequency of mail retrieval to 15min. Can I set it somewhere so that I immediately receive a notification when mail arrives (background sync allways) ?

3. The retrieval of mails and their notifications do not work reliably. I only see new mails or pushups when I switch from mobile network to wifi (or vice versa) or when I manually trigger the update in the app. How can this be optimized?

Thx.

Mero
